# iFarm – Agent Guide

- **Overview**: Monorepo with Vite React 19 frontend (HashRouter, Tailwind utility classes, framer-motion) and Express/MySQL backend in `ifarm-backend`. Frontend calls backend via `/api/v1` proxy; backend exposes `/api/v1/farms` and `/api/v1/health` plus a `/health` root check.
- **Dev workflow**: At repo root run `npm install && npm run dev` (starts Vite on 3000). Backend runs independently in `ifarm-backend` with `npm install && npm run dev`; ensure XAMPP MySQL is up and `.env.local` (or `.env`) filled before starting.
- **Env vars**: Frontend reads `GEMINI_API_KEY` via Vite define, and optional `VITE_API_BASE_URL`/`VITE_API_BASE_PATH` to override proxy (otherwise `/api` proxies to `http://localhost:4000`). Backend needs `PORT` (default 4000), `API_BASE_PATH` (default `/api/v1`), `DB_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/NAME`, and `GEMINI_API_KEY` for AI.
- **API responses**: Backend wraps JSON with `status/message/data/meta` via [ifarm-backend/src/utils/responseFormatter.js](ifarm-backend/src/utils/responseFormatter.js); errors flow through [ifarm-backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.js](ifarm-backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.js). Frontend `lib/apiClient` expects `status: "success"` and unwraps `data`, throwing `ApiError` otherwise.
- **Routing & authz**: HashRouter mounted in [index.tsx](index.tsx); per-route RBAC enforced by [security/ProtectedRoute.tsx](security/ProtectedRoute.tsx) + module/action matrix in [security/permissions.ts](security/permissions.ts). Modules include `dashboard`, `harvest`, `market`, `cold_storage`, `transport`, `weather`, `reports`, `transport_reports`, `settings`, `audit`, `optimization`.
- **User role handling**: Current role stored in `localStorage` key `ifarm-role` and provided via `RoleContext` in [App.tsx](App.tsx). Default role `ADMIN`; change by calling `setRole` or updating storage before render.
- **Settings/state**: Global settings persisted to `localStorage` (`ifarm-app-settings`) via [context/SettingsContext.tsx](context/SettingsContext.tsx); controls theme, locale, units, compact mode, animation toggle, and storage rules. Animations can be disabled by setting `enableAnimations=false`.
- **Data/mock sources**: UI uses `data/mockDb.ts` and `data/dummyData.ts` for simulated stock/transport info; `mockDb.checkStockExpiries` is invoked on load with `settings.storageConfig.alertDays`.
- **UI patterns**: Toasts managed in [App.tsx](App.tsx) with `ToastContainer` from `components/UI/Toast.tsx`; to trigger, call `addToast(message, type)` passed into child components (see `Header`). Status badges use `components/StatusChip.tsx`. Tables/cards/tabs live under `components/UI`.
- **API client**: Build endpoints via `lib/apiClient.ts` (`API_ROOT` from env), `fetchFarmSummaries(limit?, signal?)` fetches `/farms` and enforces JSON validity; pass AbortSignals for cancellation.
- **AI integrations**: Frontend helper [lib/ai.ts](lib/ai.ts) uses `@google/genai` with in-memory cache + exponential backoff; key injected as `process.env.API_KEY` from `GEMINI_API_KEY` in Vite config. Backend AI endpoint exists at [ifarm-backend/src/routes/ai.routes.js](ifarm-backend/src/routes/ai.routes.js) → [ifarm-backend/src/controllers/ai.controller.js](ifarm-backend/src/controllers/ai.controller.js) → [ifarm-backend/src/services/gemini.service.js](ifarm-backend/src/services/gemini.service.js); mount it under the API router if you need it exposed.
- **Backend DB access**: Connection pool configured in [ifarm-backend/src/config/database.js](ifarm-backend/src/config/database.js); health checks use `ping`. Farm queries live in [ifarm-backend/src/models/farmModel.js](ifarm-backend/src/models/farmModel.js) (`SELECT id, name, status FROM farms LIMIT ?`); extend models/services/controllers before wiring new routes.
- **Request logging**: [ifarm-backend/src/middleware/requestLogger.js](ifarm-backend/src/middleware/requestLogger.js) logs method/url/status/duration; `morgan` also attached with `tiny` format.
- **Proxying**: Vite dev server proxies `/api` → `http://localhost:4000`; when deploying without proxy set `VITE_API_BASE_URL` to your backend origin and keep `VITE_API_BASE_PATH` in sync with backend `API_BASE_PATH`.
- **Cold storage model**: Placeholder model at [ifarm-backend/src/models/coldstorage.model.js](ifarm-backend/src/models/coldstorage.model.js) selects all rows; reuse `getPool()` for new queries to stay within pooled connections.
- **Error handling expectations**: Throwing in controllers will be caught by `errorHandler`; prefer `next(err)` or propagate. Frontend shows `AccessDenied` when role lacks module/action.
- **Common gotchas**: AI routes are not currently mounted in [ifarm-backend/src/routes/index.js](ifarm-backend/src/routes/index.js); add them if front-end should call backend AI instead of `lib/ai.ts`. Keep hash-based routing in mind when linking. Ensure database table `farms` exists with `id/name/status` columns before hitting `/farms`.
